## Summary

Describe the problem and the behavior changed. Link any related issue.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. Note any checks that could not run.

- [ ] `npm run check` passes without lowering coverage thresholds.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Docker/Compose tests pass for API, dependency, startup, or container changes.
- [ ] Existing GET and POST API behavior remains compatible, or changes are explained below.
- [ ] README, configuration examples, policies, and changelog are updated when needed.
- [ ] No secrets, model weights, generated coverage files, or build archives are included.

## Compatibility and Privacy

Describe any deployment, API, data-handling, or default-setting changes. State any migration steps.
